_comment: Source of truth for the generated regions of self-host.html, plus the
Rendered by scripts/render-self-host.mjs, which runs as part of `npm run build`.
Never hand-edit between the markers in those files; edit this and re-render.
published: false until the image is public on GHCR. While it is false the page
is noindex, it is left out of the sitemap and llms.txt, and it carries a short
note saying the image is not published yet. Flip it to true, run npm run build,
and the page goes live. Nothing else has to change.
devices: the honest state of each surface. Never write Works for something
nobody has run. status is the short label; state picks the pill colour and must
be one of ok, unconfirmed, unknown, na.

devices.detail: Chrome, Safari and Firefox on a Mac
devices.note: Tested. This is the surface the tuner is built for.
The phone and tablet layout is built and checked in a headless browser, but nobody has run it on a real device yet. If you try it, tell me what happened.

devices.detail: Fire TV Silk, Google TV with a sideloaded browser, Samsung and LG
devices.note: No test results at all, good or bad. TV browsers vary a lot and some of them cannot decode surround audio.
tvOS has no web browser. The free App Store app does this job properly, with the Siri Remote and no mixed-content rule.
Roku has no web browser, so there is nothing to open the tuner in.
